newsitem.title: USA: Iomega says Gateway to offer drives.
newsitem.headline: Iomega says Gateway to offer drives.

text.p: Iomega Corp said on Tuesday that Gateway 2000 Inc is offering its customers Iomega's Zip or Jaz drives as options for personal computers.
The Jaz drive will be preinstalled and will offer storage capacity at speeds matching many existing hard drives, a statement from Iomega said.

The Zip drives and 100MB Zip disks offer an easy to use personal storage solution designed to make it easier for consumers to move, protect, use, share and backup personal information on their computers.
Iomega said it and Gateway share the belief that new multi-media applications, operating systems and Internet services are creating greater storage demand.
